description.from: Move web_jobs payload/result out of the catalog journal into records. Depends on S1.
description.to:
Move each article's result (jobs in the catalog) out into records.
Acceptance: one-worker-at-a-time job claims preserved in the small control state; never-pay-twice unaffected; reads fall back to the old embedded form during migration; contract specs on every backend. Depends on S1.
